scope: Actual Express/JWT/PostgreSQL with synthetic status/inbox records; no external delivery or legal-state proof
checks: Assigned staff status change atomically creates an actual recipient-scoped client inbox entry
Concurrent duplicate transition creates one audit/notification rather than duplicate side effects
Actual AuditLog failure rolls back status and all coupled records
Actual OpsInsight failure rolls back status and all coupled records
Another same-company account cannot mark a client notification read
Read state is saved and mapped from actual isRead/readAt fields
Notification mutations cannot alter unrelated OPS records
Malformed pagination and tenant-admin global fanout are denied
Access tokens in notification stream URLs no longer authenticate
External notification navigation cannot be inserted through the service
Administrative case edit response preserves financial disclosure restrictions
Assignment saves its audit and employee inbox, duplicate assignment is a no-op, former assignee loses access
edit coupled-record failure rolls back actual case changes
assign coupled-record failure rolls back actual case changes
Calendar rollover and inactive employee assignment are rejected
Case assignee selector exposes active company employees and safe fields only
